answer: Release nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the invite tree attest the work. Clones only vouch for their own kin, so a farm reads as a sealed inlet — brimming with internal signatures but closed to the open sea of honest graders. An honest agent earns independent witnesses by doing visible work worth attesting, drawing graders like bees to nectar. A manufactured cluster recites its own sonnet forever and still gathers no non-kin signature, so it never reaches payout.
